question: Which banks have the highest uninsured deposit share?
headline: In 2026Q2, State Street Bank and Trust Company had the highest uninsured deposit share at 102.28%, followed by John Deere Financial, f.s.b. (99.9999%) and Northwestern Mutual Wealth Management (99.91%).
insights: The top 15 banks by uninsured deposit share are mostly trust companies and specialty banks, and most have under $1B in assets; State Street is also the largest of them by assets at $412.6B.

Shares above 100% (State Street at 102.28%) are possible because the uninsured estimate includes collateralized public funds and affiliate deposits, while the denominator is domestic deposits only. Read them as estimates, not strict percentages.
The whole industry's aggregate uninsured deposit share is 45.47%, so the top 15 sit more than twice that level; the list is cut off at 15, so only the top end of the ranking is complete.

question: Compare uninsured, non-interest-bearing and brokered deposit shares for New England banking organizations with $10B-$50B in assets, 2026Q2
headline: In 2026Q2, Eastern Bankshares had the highest uninsured deposit share (41.56%) of the three New England organizations with $10B-$50B in assets, while Independent Bank Corp (MA) had the highest non-interest-bearing share (28.47%) and Beacon Financial the highest brokered share (1.24%).
insights: Uninsured deposit share ranges from 33.49% (Independent Bank Corp (MA)) to 41.56% (Eastern Bankshares); Beacon Financial is at 38.34%. The peer aggregate is 38.10%.
Non-interest-bearing share ranges from 21.97% (Beacon Financial) to 28.47% (Independent Bank Corp (MA)); Eastern Bankshares is at 25.88%. The peer aggregate is 25.58%.
Brokered share is low across the group: Beacon Financial 1.24%, Eastern Bankshares 0.43%, Independent Bank Corp (MA) 0.29%. The peer aggregate is 0.62%.

Eastern Bankshares is also the largest of the three at $31.1B in assets, Independent Bank Corp (MA) is $25.0B and Beacon Financial is $22.2B. Shares are aggregates on quarter-end balances, by organization (holding company).
